raw_text: {"overall_diagnosis":"The task failed because the workflow for editing an embedded Excel workbook inside a PPTX did not reliably preserve or refresh formula-derived values and cached calculation results after modification. Document that libraries like openpyxl may clear cached formula results, causing downstream readers to see blanks/NaN. Include techniques for forcing recalculation metadata, retaining cached values, or using recalculation-capable engines before save.
